name: cx-sequence~p1
task: First find the key and then pick it up. After that, open the locked door, enter the room, and then pick up the ball.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The four hard Precedence clauses follow the stated order (find key, pick up key, open door, enter room, pick up ball), and the hard Existence(target_picked_up) forces the whole chain. No earlier step has its own Existence, and all clauses are hard because the task gives no preference cue.

texts: Pick up the matching key only after the key has been found.
Open the locked door only after the matching key has been picked up.
Enter the target room only after the locked door has been opened.
Pick up the target ball only after entering the target room.
Pick up the target ball, which ends the ordered sequence and forces the earlier steps.
